final: WITH line_totals AS (SELECT link_to_budget, SUM(cost) AS total_cost, COUNT(*) AS expense_count FROM expense GROUP BY link_to_budget), overall AS (SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_total FROM line_totals) SELECT AVG(l.total_cost) AS average_above_average_total, SUM(l.expense_count) AS total_expenses, AVG(l.total_cost - o.average_total) AS average_excess FROM line_totals AS l CROSS JOIN overall AS o WHERE l.total_cost > o.average_total
